Anya (Docs): Heads-up: I'm drafting a compact docs style PR to align voice and product names. Quick input: tone, canonical names, and a couple glossary entries?
Sam (Eng): Keep it engineer-friendly but not cryptic. Use branded names on first mention (Redwood API, Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Private), then short forms.
Kai (Product): Agrees. Tone: factual + pragmatic. Call out tradeoffs (latency vs cost).
Anya (Docs): Draft glossary snippet for "Serving runtime": 'The GPU-optimized inference engine that executes requests, manages KV cache, and selects optimized kernels based on model and workload (see /eng-runtime).' Also add parenthetical about batching affecting latency vs throughput.
Emma (Docs): Add SDK snippet guidance: prefer official SDK usage and consistent variable names. Example: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'; const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY }); await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Summarize' });`
Sam (Eng): FYI internal docs still use "reserved capacity" and "dedicated pool". I'll grep and paste links in PR for minimal edits.
Anya (Docs): I'll include a migration checklist in the PR: search/replace deprecated variants, update examples, fix internal links to eng-runtime, and add short tooltips for product pages.
Kai (Product): Add one-liner for Private: 'Redwood Private 14 customer-managed control plane for VPC or on-prem deployments.'
doc-bot: New PR opened by Anya (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/438 "docs: style + naming glossary (microfixes)"
Emma (Docs): Will review tomorrow morning and flag any exact-string tests that might break.
Anya (Docs): Thanks all 14 aiming for surgical docs-only changes. Closing thread, will iterate in PR comments. :sparkles:
